description: This is a test class for NotificationDriverImpl, testing notification channel initialization, permission handling, and notification cancellation in an Android environment using Robolectric.

classes.name: NotificationDriverImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for NotificationDriverImpl, testing notification channel setup, permission requests, and notification cancellation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the NotificationDriverImpl instance before each test.

methods.name: testInitializeChannelsForProduction
methods.description: Verifies that notification channels are correctly initialized for production mode.

methods.name: testInitializeChannelsForTesters
methods.description: Verifies that notification channels are correctly initialized for tester mode.

methods.name: testDoubleInitFails
methods.description: Ensures that initializing channels twice throws a RuntimeException.

methods.name: testAlwaysHavePermissionToPostNotification
methods.description: Checks that permission to post notifications is granted on SDK version S_V2.

methods.name: testReturnsTrueIfAlreadyHasPermission
methods.description: Verifies that permission check returns true if permission is already granted on SDK version TIRAMISU.

methods.name: testCancelsNotifications
methods.description: Tests that notifications can be canceled properly.
